observation.command:
WEBIP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' ddev-tfm-fachplanung-web); echo "WEBIP=$WEBIP"
docker run --rm --user 1000:1000 -v /workspace:/e2e -w /e2e \
  --network ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default --add-host web:$WEBIP \
  -e CYPRESS_baseUrl=http://web \
  -e CYPRESS_user_r1=r1_user -e CYPRESS_pass_r1=r1_password \
  cypress/included:latest run --spec "cypress/e2e/02-benutzerverwaltung.cy.js" 2>&1 | tail -50; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
